### Editorial and Contents

**Editor:** Amanda Pandagirl
**Writers:** Dave Fountain, Clare Bear
**Hacker:** Jeff Cooper

Released 04.09.94 by Fountain PD Software (2 Belvoir Rd, West Bridgford, Nottingham, NG2 5DL).

Official distribution by Alchemist Research, Fish Mag, Prism PD and Womo PD. We request that PD libraries don't charge even a minimal copy fee for this fanzine. Sod your electricity bill! Free means free. Thanks.
